items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: And is Hamilton definitely going to be virtual?

ctx.x: I think it’s a scary thought amongst many scary thoughts about actually starting the semester with online lessons. It’s one thing to finish out five or six weeks, but to actually just start it, I mean people do it, some people do it as a matter, a regular system. But I’m not looking forward to that myself.
No. And is Hamilton definitely going to be virtual?
They actually, the last thing I heard was hopeful but that could change.
